description: Example team overlay on the default-deny posture: stricter migration rule, actor-conditional deploy approvals, and an explicit allow-list your workflows' policy gates must stay inside. Copy and tighten; enterprise SSO/RBAC/audit-export stay demand-gated.

rules.message: destructive action denied by team policy (stricter than default: all envs, not just prod)
agent-driven deployments require a recorded human approval
protected-branch merges require a recorded human approval
spend and provisioning require a recorded human approval
read-local pipeline actions permitted (extend only deliberately)
